Travel Vocabulary and Reading Travel Vocabulary and Reading Students will be able to define and use at least 10 travel-related vocabulary words in context. Students will be able to identify the main idea and supporting details in a reading passage about travel planning. Students will be able to extract specific information from the text to answer comprehension questions.

Planning a Trip Planning a Trip Students will be able to extract key information from a travel-related reading passage. Students will be able to use travel planning vocabulary and sentence patterns to discuss and write a simple travel plan. Students will be able to present their travel plan orally with increased confidence.

Presenting Your Travel Plan Presenting Your Travel Plan Students will be able to orally present a simple travel plan using key vocabulary and sentence patterns. Students will be able to organize a travel plan presentation with clear structure (destination, route, budget, preparation). Students will be able to deliver a short presentation with increased confidence and clarity.

Travel Vocabulary and Planning Basics Travel Vocabulary and Planning Basics Students will be able to identify and use at least 10 travel-related vocabulary words in context. Students will be able to use key sentence patterns to discuss travel plans, such as 'I'm planning to...' and 'It's better to...'. Students will be able to extract key information from a short travel passage and apply it to a planning task.

Reading and Extracting Travel Information Reading and Extracting Travel Information Students will be able to identify the main idea and supporting details in a travel-related passage. Students will be able to extract specific information (e.g., destinations, transportation, budgeting tips) from the text. Students will be able to use graphic organizers to summarize key information from the reading.

Creating and Presenting a Travel Plan Creating and Presenting a Travel Plan Students will be able to use travel-related vocabulary and sentence patterns to describe a travel plan. Students will be able to organize information logically in a written travel plan. Students will be able to present a travel plan orally with confidence and clarity.
